description.en: Boson AI conversational TTS model for expressive speech across 100+ languages, zero-shot voice cloning, and inline control over emotion, style, prosody, pauses, and sound effects.
description.zh: Boson AI 对话式 TTS 模型，覆盖 100+ 语言的富有表现力语音、零样本音色克隆，以及情绪、风格、韵律、停顿与音效的行内控制。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated AR tokens; zero uses the default. Must not exceed the configured context length.
max_tokens.zh: 最大生成 AR 代币；零使用默认值。不得超过配置的上下文长度。

temperature.en: AR sampling temperature. Must be positive.
temperature.zh: AR 采样温度。必须是积极的。

top_k.zh: 自回归 top-k 采样上限。

top_p.en: AR nucleus sampling probability. Must be positive.
top_p.zh: AR 核采样概率。必须是积极的。

repetition_penalty.en: Accepted for Python API compatibility; audio sampling does not consume this value. Compatibility-only, but must be finite and positive.
repetition_penalty.zh: 因 Python API 兼容性而被接受；音频采样不消耗该值。仅限兼容性，但必须是有限且正的。

seed.en: Torch sampling seed; omitted chooses a random seed.
seed.zh: 火炬取样种子；省略选择随机种子。

stream_frames_per_event.en: Streaming codec frames per event; grow starts at one and increases to this cap. Each frame is 40 ms of audio.
stream_frames_per_event.zh: 每个流式事件的 codec 帧数；grow 从 1 开始增加到该上限。每帧为 40 ms 音频。

stream_chunk_policy.en: Streaming chunk schedule. The non-causal codec always retains ten frames of left and right context.
stream_chunk_policy.zh: 流式分块调度。非因果 codec 始终保留左右各 10 帧上下文。

allow_incomplete_generation.en: Return generated audio with a warning instead of failing when max_tokens is reached before EOC. Audio may be truncated or contain silence/noise.
allow_incomplete_generation.zh: 达到 max_tokens 仍未 EOC 时，返回已生成音频并警告，而不是失败。音频可能被截断或包含静音/噪声。

filter_nan_logits.en: Filter NaN and infinity during greedy and stochastic top-k selection. All-invalid logits still fail.
filter_nan_logits.zh: 在贪心和随机 top-k 选择中过滤 NaN 与无穷值；全部无效 logits 仍会失败。

reference_text.zh: 参考音频对应的转写文本。
